correctness.rationale: A rank7 b omits exactly one output, so unique cyclic conjugacy normalizes its image to {1,...,7}; choose repeated output (7), preimage pair C(8,2), bijection of remaining six outputs 6! for exactly 141120 cases without duplication. BFS from full 8-bit set on subset transitions induced by rotation and b gives exact shortest word or non-synchronizing (at most 255 nonempty subsets); no search length cutoff. In this run an independently written C++ complete generator/BFS visited all 141120 normalized cases and matched all 32 bins in repository spectrum.csv, including rare thresholds and no missing values. The 1856 nonsync count equals 1728 mod2 +192 mod4−64 overlap, consistent with primitive/defect-one theorem. This is an exhaustive finite proof for this precise family, not a claim about all binary automata.
